bug_semantics: RAGFlow's agent workflow "Invoke" HTTP component (agent/component/invoke.py) builds an outbound request URL from canvas configuration plus runtime template variables and passes it directly to requests.get / requests.post / requests.put — WITHOUT calling the shared assert_url_is_safe validator or pinning the resolved address (pin_dns), unlike the crawler, SearXNG, file-upload, and RSS fetch paths which all use the ssrf_guard. A user who can create or trigger an agent directs the server to fetch loopback, link-local, and RFC 1918 destinations (cloud metadata endpoints, co-located services), and the response body is returned as component output — readable SSRF (CWE-918).
flaw_origin: Commit adb0a93d955ca5d6117c871a77d0c3eadb02fa6b ("add component invoke (#2967)", 2024-10-22, author Kevin Hu <kevinhu.sh@gmail.com>, committer GitHub) created agent/component/invoke.py with the unguarded outbound calls: `url = self._param.url.strip(); if url.find("http") != 0: url = "http://" + url; ... requests.get(url=url, ...)` / `requests.put(url=url, ...)` with no SSRF validation. Parent 226bdd6e99 lacks invoke.py entirely (introducer_parent_absent=true). The shared ssrf_guard module (assert_url_is_safe/pin_dns) already existed and was used by sibling components (crawler) when invoke.py was written — the flaw is that the new component never adopted it.
ai_marker: absent — the BIC commit object names author Kevin Hu <kevinhu.sh@gmail.com>, committer GitHub <noreply@github.com>, human PR message (#2967, issue #2908); no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or bot/AI identity anywhere on the object.

reasoning: Field reconciliation 2026-08-29 (see evidence tail). Vulnerability first: the advisory names the exact missing guard (assert_url_is_safe/pin_dns before requests.*) on the Invoke component; the v0.26.2 blob shows the raw requests.* calls, and the fix adds precisely those guards matching crawler/SearXNG — proving the missing SSRF validation is the defect. BIC choice: invoke.py was created wholesale by adb0a93d955c (2024-10-22) with the unguarded outbound flow; the parent lacks the file, making the BIC the unique introducer — sibling components that already used the guard establish that the guard adoption failure began at file creation. Squash check: single feature PR, not a decomposed squash; squash_decomposed=false.
